```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(reactable)
library(pins)
library(gt)
library(nanoparquet)
library(tictoc)

# Load helper functions
source("R/hubspot-helpers.R")

# Set up token
hubspot_token <- Sys.getenv("HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN")
if (hubspot_token == "") {
  stop(
    "HubSpot access token not found. Please set HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN environment variable."
  )
}
tic("Total ETL time")
```

## ETL Process for HubSpot Deals

### Load existing data if available

```{r}
tic("Load existing data")
# Check if data exists as a pin
board <- board_connect()

deals_pin_exists <- FALSE
deal_history_pin_exists <- FALSE

try(
  {
    deals <- board |> pin_read("deals") 
    deals_pin_exists <- TRUE
  },
  silent = TRUE
)

try(
  {
    deal_history <- board |> pin_read("deal_history") 
    deal_history_pin_exists <- TRUE
  },
  silent = TRUE
)

if (deals_pin_exists & deal_history_pin_exists) {
  last_deal_update <- max(deals$modified_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("Loaded existing data from pins\n")
  cat("Deals:", nrow(deals), "\n")
  cat("Deal history records:", nrow(deal_history), "\n")
  cat("Last deal modified date:", last_deal_update, "\n")
} else {
  cat("No existing pins found, will fetch fresh data\n")
  last_deal_update <- today() 
}
toc()
```



### Get the stages for deals and all deals with creation time
```{r get-specific-deal}
# Get custom stage labels
stages <- get_stages()

# Get all deals with  time stats
all_deals <- get_all_deals_with_creation()

# Show summary
cat("Total deals:", nrow(all_deals), "\n")
cat(sprintf("Ignoring deals modified before:%s\n",
            as.character(last_deal_update)))


latest_deals <- all_deals |>
  filter(modified_date >= last_deal_update)

cat("Remaining deals:", nrow(latest_deals), "\n")
cat(
  "Date range:",
  paste0(range(latest_deals$modified_date), collapse = ' to '),
  "\n"
)


```

### Get deal histories and join with deal info
```{r deal-history}
tic("Get deal histories")
if (exists("deals") & exists("deal_history")) {
  previous_deal_data <- deals |> filter(!deal_id %in% latest_deals$deal_id)
  previous_deal_history <- deal_history |>
    filter(!deal_id %in% latest_deals$deal_id)
}
update_deal_history <- get_deal_history(latest_deals$deal_id)
update_deal_history_count <- update_deal_history |>
  count(deal_id, name = "n_history")

# Join with deal info
update_deals <- latest_deals |>
  left_join(update_deal_history_count, by = "deal_id") |>
  left_join(stages, by = c("stage" = "stage_id"))

if (exists("previous_deal_data")) {
  deals <- bind_rows(previous_deal_data, update_deals)
  deal_history <- bind_rows(previous_deal_history, update_deal_history)
} else {
  deals <- update_deals
  deal_history <- update_deal_history
}
toc()
```

### Pin the data for future use
```{r pin-deals}
board <- board_connect()
board |>
  pin_write(
    deals,
    "deals",
    type = "parquet",
    description = "All deals with history count"
  )
board |>
  pin_write(
    deal_history,
    "deal_history",
    type = "parquet",
    description = "Deal history records"
  )

```

## Some deals don't have history
```{r}
deals |> 
  mutate(has_history = ! is.na(n_history)) |>
  count(has_history) |>
  gt()
```


## Deals Lookup
```{r}
deals |>
  select(-stage, -pipeline) |>
  reactable(
    searchable = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      deal_id = colDef(name = "Deal ID"),
      deal_name = colDef(name = "Deal Name"),
      amount = colDef(name = "Amount", format = colFormat(currency = "USD")),
      stage_label = colDef(name = "Stage"),
      created_date = colDef(name = "Created"),
      modified_date = colDef(name = "Modified"),
      close_date = colDef(name = "Close Date"),
      n_history = colDef(name = "History Count")
    )
  )
```

## Deal History Lookup

```{r}
#default the DealID to the first deal with history
default_deal_id <- deals |> filter(n_history > 0) |> slice(1) |> pull(deal_id)

deal_history |>
  reactable(
    searchable = TRUE,
    filterable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 25,
    columns = list(
      deal_id = colDef(
        name = "Deal ID",
        searchable = TRUE,
        filterable = TRUE,
      ),
      ts = colDef(name = "Timestamp"),
      amount = colDef(name = "Amount", format = colFormat(currency = "USD")),
      stage_id = colDef(name = "Stage ID"),
      stage_label = colDef(name = "Stage"),
      user_name = colDef(name = "User")
    )
  )
```
